name: @pierre/trees
summary: Open-source file tree rendering library for the web, built for extreme performance on trees of tens of thousands of files.
description: A file tree library with one path-first model shared across React, vanilla JS and SSR entry points. Ships search with three match modes, drag and drop, rename, Git status badges, context menu composition, built-in icon tiers, Shiki theme support, CSS-variable styling, adjustable density and automatic virtualization; ARIA tree roles and keyboard navigation are built in.
contains: React hook (useFileTree, FileTree), vanilla JS class and SSR entry points; npm @pierre/trees
7 gallery examples: React, Search, Git Status, Density, Item Customization, Drag And Drop, Responsiveness
three icon tiers: minimal, standard, complete; Shiki theme support
agent skill and plain-text docs (llms.txt, llms-full.txt)
